title: Scan TODOs / FIXMEs
intro: Read this when you want to see the outstanding work left in code: it lists TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, REVIEW and NOTE markers in a path, as text or JSON.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Code Quality > Scan TODOs / FIXMEs...
steps: Choose drag-lint > Code Quality > Scan TODOs / FIXMEs...
Read the list of markers (TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, REVIEW, NOTE)

questions.ask: Which TODO, FIXME or HACK comments are left in my code?
How do I list them as JSON?
